hero_lede: Connect your desktop and phone without handing the cloud your conversations.
hero_fine: The cloud routes encrypted records. Pairing is always approved on your desktop. This console never opens or executes a chat.
reset_help: Resetting your password revokes cloud sessions. It does not recover encryption keys. Sign in again from your client.
admin_help: Only administrators can sign in to this website. An administrator username works in both modes; no email is required.
admin_default_help: A new installation uses admin/admin for the first password-change screen. No initialization code is needed. Sign in and change the password immediately after deployment; public default credentials can be claimed by another visitor.
hosted_admin_help: Hosted users register and sign in through their clients with a verified email address. They cannot sign in to this website.
selfhost_admin_help: Local users are created by the administrator and sign in through their clients. Public registration, official billing and ordinary-user website login are disabled.
setup_help: You must set a different, strong password before any account or management access is allowed. You may also change the username. This setup session expires in 10 minutes; sign in again after saving.
setup_action: Save credentials and sign in again
setup_complete: Administrator credentials changed. Sign in with your new password.
footer_open_source: AGPLv3 source / No offline command queue
network_error: Unable to connect. Refresh the page and try again.
password_reset_notice: Password reset. Sign in again from your client. Encryption keys are not recovered.
user_created_notice: Local account created. This user can sign in through clients, not this website.
password_mismatch: The new passwords do not match.
error_authentication_required: Your session has expired. Sign in again.
error_csrf_required: Security check failed. Refresh the page and try again.
error_https_required: This server accepts HTTPS connections only.
error_administrator_web_only: Only administrators can sign in to this website. Use your client for an ordinary account.
error_administrator_setup_required: Your setup session has expired. Sign in again to restart setup.
error_password_change_required: Set a different password. The current password cannot be reused during setup.
error_invalid_password: Use a password containing 12 to 256 bytes.
error_invalid_username: Use 3 to 64 lower-case letters, digits, dots, underscores or hyphens for the username.
error_invalid_email_token: This password reset link is invalid, expired or already used. Request a new link from your client.
error_rate_limited: Too many attempts. Wait before trying again.
error_state_conflict: The record has changed or the username is in use. Refresh and try again.
error_invalid_code_batch: Check the number of codes and service days.
error_invalid_redemption: The redemption code or request is invalid.
error_cannot_disable_current_administrat: You cannot disable your current administrator account.
error_use_verified_email_reset: Hosted user passwords must be reset through verified email.
error_hosted_users_require_email_verific: Hosted users must register through clients and verify their email.
error_registration_disabled: Public registration is disabled on this server.
error_redemption_disabled: Service-day redemption is disabled in self-host mode.
home_heading: Connect in your client. Operate in your console.
home_help: This is the service homepage. Account sign-in, pairing and service redemption belong in your client; administrators use a separate operations console.
home_step_desktop_help: Sign in to your cloud account in the desktop client. Hosted users verify their email first.
home_step_pair_help: Scan the desktop QR code on your phone, then confirm the local keys on desktop.
home_step_connect_help: Your desktop and phone exchange encrypted messages; the server relays, never controls your conversations.
home_admin_help: The console is for administrators managing users, connections and security records. Ordinary users use their clients.
admin_boundary_help: Accounts, connections and security records only. Conversations and device approval stay with your clients.
overview_help: Monitor live server connections and manage users and security.
metric_gateways_help: Desktop gateways currently connected to this server
hosted_users_help: Ordinary users register and verify email in their clients. Manage account status here; issue codes in the separate redemption-code section.
selfhost_users_help: Administrators create local accounts; ordinary users sign in through their clients.
latest_users_help: Search all accounts; load more results below.
admin_devices_help: Choose a user in Accounts to view their desktops, phones and bindings. Revocation only removes access; approving a device still requires the desktop.
admin_sessions_help: Sign-in records for the selected account. Revoking a session invalidates that sign-in without recovering encryption keys.
audit_help: Authorization and management changes with actor, affected account and before/after state. Load more to inspect earlier records. Credentials and conversation content are excluded.
runtime_capacity_help: Online counts represent current connections, not total devices or a capacity guarantee. Deployment capacity requires independent load testing.
panels_load_failed: Some data could not be loaded. Available panels remain usable; refresh to retry.
error_redemption_client_only: Redeem service in your client. Redemption is not available in the administrator console.
codes_admin_help: Administrators generate, export and revoke service-day codes. Users redeem in their clients, not in this console.
code_export_help: Each generation creates one batch of 1-100 codes, each worth 1-3650 days. An account can redeem only one code per batch; other batches can extend service. New codes contain 16 random letters/digits. The server stores only digests; keep the CSV private.
error_redemption_batch_already_used: This account has already redeemed a code from this batch. Use a different batch.
code_download_help: Copy an actual redemption code below, or save the CSV. Leaving this page or generating another batch clears these codes from the page.
latest_codes_help: Load more to inspect earlier records. Current-batch codes can be copied here; earlier plaintext is available only in its original CSV. Record IDs cannot be redeemed.
generated_codes_heading: Actual redemption codes in this batch
code_copied_notice: Actual redemption code copied. Paste it into the desktop client to redeem.
code_copy_failed: Automatic copy failed. The redemption code is selected; copy it manually.
code_plaintext_help: Use the original CSV code column. The record ID cannot be redeemed.
redemptions_admin_help: Client redemptions with account, service-day and activation records. Load more to view earlier entries.
codes_generated_notice: Actual redemption codes are shown below. Copy a code or save the batch CSV; the server cannot recover plaintext later.
code_generation_uncertain: The generation result could not be confirmed; codes may already exist. Refresh the list and check before resubmitting. Revoke inaccessible codes before generating a replacement batch.
error_invalid_page: This list position is invalid. Refresh the list.
error_invalid_search: Enter a valid username, email or account ID.
error_invalid_device_role: Choose a desktop or phone device list.
campaigns_help: Gift service to new accounts completing verified-email registration during an enabled campaign. Only one unfinished campaign is allowed, including drafts and scheduled campaigns. Issued service remains valid after the campaign ends.
campaign_starts_help: Leave blank to start on activation.
campaign_timezone: Times are entered and displayed in your browser timezone: {zone}.
campaign_confirm_activate: Activate “{name}”? The saved rules will be locked. Each eligible new account receives service once.
campaign_confirm_stop: End “{name}” permanently? It cannot be resumed. Previously issued service stays valid.
campaign_saved: Draft saved. Activate it when ready.
error_invalid_registration_campaign: Enter a campaign name, 1–3650 days, a positive optional quota, and an end time later than the start. Activation requires a future end time.
error_registration_campaign_already_open: An unfinished campaign already exists. End it before creating the next.
error_registration_campaign_locked: Only drafts can be edited. Enabled rules are fixed, and ended campaigns cannot be resumed. Refresh to see the latest state.
error_registration_campaigns_disabled: Registration campaigns are available in hosted mode only.
